about: A Zork II style cave-and-garden adventure. A Wizard curses you, treasures lie south of a ravine, and there is a formal garden with a gazebo and a unicorn.

done.why: The Carousel Room, a disorienting maze with eight identical exits, felt like a chore. I had seen no puzzle or goal that pulled me in, so I quit.

moments.note: The Wizard appeared, cursed me and made me drop the lamp, with a custom reaction to my empty hands.
The newspaper gave a fun in-world hint about the Wizard and the treasures.
Carousel Room maze with identical exits.

wished: Not meeting a maze so soon

lines.line: His eye goes to your hands, which hold nothing he values, and he relaxes a little
lines.why: A nice reactive touch from the Wizard.

fun.why: Familiar and competent, but nothing grabbed me.

engagement.why: No hook before I hit the maze.

interestingness.why: Zork homage with some reactive touches.

prose.why: Clean, evocative room descriptions and a witty newspaper.
